featured_reviews.name: Saud Ahmed Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text: I just loved the place. There is something for everyone and for every age. There are some good games to play and much more to win. Remember to make your TimeZone Card before playing. Once you made the card you can refill it again and again when your amount is less. There are 3 types of card Red, Blue and Gold. All cards are exclusive and have own benefit. Once card in made, all u need is tap and play. For most of the games you play, you win tickets which you can redeem for prizes. It's really fantastic place to chill, relax and spend some quality time with your loved ones. I highly recommend this place to family and friends. Go and enjoy. Just keep watch on your tickets and belongings as there is rush on some days.

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Varma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated my son’s Xth birthday at the newly opened Timezone (Skycity Mall Borivali)🎉🎳 Amazing experience!
The host Vidhi Vyas was bang on and managed a group of 24 super-energetic kids so smoothly. Bowling, dashing cars, and the overall games experience were a big hit with the kids.
Everything was well planned, stress-free, and full of fun. Highly recommend for birthday parties! 😊👏

featured_reviews.name: Guru Gym Foodie
featured_reviews.review_text: 10 pin Bowling in TimeZone. On Thursdays there is a waiting line of 200 people. Waiting time varies from 2 hours to 5 hours. After 4 pm the rate on Thursdays is just Rs.99. But it is amazing how Irshad and Shahid manage the crowd so well. The others too keep the crowd disciplined. I go regularly, so I must say I am impressed with both of them (er, the others I do not remember their names). They encourage me by lauding my bowling and scores. In fact I scored 168 today based on the demo given by Irshad. Amazing how Sky City Mall has become so popular and so crowded. I thank all the staff for their excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Arshad Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an awesome time at Timezone Sky City! The bowling alley was fantastic—clean, fun, and really well-maintained. The atmosphere was energetic and perfect for a great day out.

A special shout-out to Irsad, who provided exceptional service. He was friendly, helpful, and made the experience even better with his professionalism and positive attitude. Staff like him truly make a difference!

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fun activities and great customer service.

If you want it shorter, more formal, or more enthusiastic, just let me know!🤩💯

featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.name: dipti shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: Deepti and Vidhi from Timezone, Sky City Mall, Borivali were absolutely fantastic hosts. Both were energetic, engaging, and handled the party with great dedication. Their enthusiasm truly made the experience memorable.

featured_reviews.name: nilesh singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Sky City Timezone gaming zone! The overall ambience was lively and well-maintained – perfect for a fun day out. The staff were super friendly and helpful throughout.

Special shoutout to *Muskan* at the Carnival Duck Fishing games. She was so cheerful, patient, and made the experience extra fun for us. Thanks to her guidance, we won lots of prizes!

We enjoyed a lot and will definitely visit again. Highly recommend this place for families and friends.

featured_reviews.name: 63 Nikhil Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience at Timezone! The place was clean, fun, and well-maintained with lots of games and activities. The employees were very friendly, helpful, and professional. They assisted quickly whenever needed and made the overall experience even better. Excellent customer service and a great atmosphere. Would definitely visit again!”

A special thanks to Irsad from the staff. He was very friendly, helpful, and made the visit even better with his great customer service.

Food was very good we had Truffle mushroom soup,  Jalapeño & Cheese poppers, Classic chicken Tikka, Jalapeño corn Mexican pizza, Thai curry with rice and Butter chicken with lacchha paratha, everything was super delicious. The staff was nice and helpful. Our entire family joined in the game of bowling which almost took us around 40 mins to finish, it was totally fun activity for all of us. They also have happy hour for bowling and some food combos. The washrooms were clean and tidy, they have valet parking facility... so over all it was great experience for our entire family, we were at The Game Ranch for more than 3½ hours and we liked every minute we spent there, I will be definitely coming here more often for complete fun experience and tasty food.

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Khalid Sarfaraz
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Game Ranch is located in Mindspace Malad and it is easy to find. They have one more outlet in Powai.

The restaurant is huge primarily because they have arcade games, full size bowling alley, a huge bar and different seating options. The ambiance is rustic as they have created a ranch type setting with wooden seatings and a cute stable. The bar looks excellent and everywhere they have tried to add different elements which makes the overall place look good.

They serve multi cuisine and the menu here is huge. Options from burgers, pizzas, Indian cuisine to Chinese and sizzlers are also available. Prices are at par with similar type of brands and the quantity served is decent.

Went here for a weekday dinner and the place had a great vibe due to people enjoying games and DJ playing great music. The kitchen service was on time and table service by Staff Rakesh was perfect.

What We Had -
APPETISERS~
Wok Tossed Kung Pao Chicken. 4/5
Classic American Hot Dog. 5/5

MAINS~
Mushroom Porcini Cream Truffle Pasta. 5/5
Chicken Tikka Sizzler. 5/5

DESSERT~
Chocolate Hazelnut Mud Cake. 4/5

DRINKS~
Tall Tiki Mofo. 5/5
Mixed Feelings. 5/5

So our meal at The Game Ranch was indeed one of a kind experience as we loved the food, music and the games available can be enjoyed by all. Therefore do visit them.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited The Game Ranch located at A Wing, Rajan Pada, Mindspace, Malad West, Mumbai, and it turned out to be a really fun and enjoyable experience.

Ambience:
The place has a super lively and energetic vibe. It’s known for its gaming-themed concept, making it a great hangout spot with friends. The atmosphere is vibrant, youthful, and perfect if you’re looking to chill, play, eat, and have a good time all in one place.

Cuisine:
They serve a mix of continental-style comfort food, bar bites, and crowd-favorite dishes that pair really well with their drinks and mocktails.

What we tried:

Mocktails:
• Raspberry and Grapefruit Gimlet – Refreshing with a nice tangy twist
• Tinderella – Unique, well-balanced, and very enjoyable

Food:
• The Empire State Chicken Burger – Juicy, filling, and full of flavor
• Chicken Popcorn with Spice Remoulade – Crispy outside, tender inside, and the dip made it even better
• Tempura Fried Prawns – Light, crunchy, and perfectly cooked
• Chicken Kheema Pav – Spicy, comforting, and packed with taste

Dessert:
• Baked Philadelphia Cheesecake – Super creamy, rich, and perfectly sweet. A must-try for dessert lovers!

Service:
The service and management were good, staff was polite and attentive, which made the experience even better.

Overall:
If you’re in Malad West, this spot definitely deserves to be on your list — perfect for food, fun, and good vibes with friends.

featured_reviews.name: Chandu B
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff aggressively pushes you to buy a game card with a minimum recharge of ₹3,100 instead of clearly explaining the available options. The combo packages are poorly designed and misleading they ended up charging us more than the advertised combo prices. To make matters worse, one of the combos included “5 arcade games,” but the card only worked on a limited selection of arcade machines. Many of the games we actually wanted to play either weren’t covered by the combo or weren’t functional at all. Paying a premium only to find several machines out of service made the experience feel like terrible value for money. Definitely not what you’d expect from a place that’s marketed as a premium entertainment destination. Most of the 5 stars reviews are definitely fake!

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: We went here primarily for bowling. We purchased an offline card. We paid 3100 plus tax(3600) and got 3500 as balance. We also got a BOGO offer in bowling. We selected VIP bowling and it had animation and graphics on the bowling floor and of course the normal bowling was crowded. They have very good combination of arcade and normal games and we had fun here. Staff was very helpful and we had some issues with machine and my card got swiped multiple times. They understood my issue and offered me different games. We collected lot of tickets which acts like a currency for some of the items. They have a free bowling round on birthdays. They also have lot of offers and we got few extra bonus points for their social media posts.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Rajeshirke
featured_reviews.review_text: Best experience and worth it. Had so much fun with friends. Also the staff is very humble and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Saunskaar Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited SHOTT Mumbai for my college event, and it was an amazing experience. The venue offers a fantastic arcade, a bowling area, a section for drinks and snacks, and dedicated rooms for parties and events. The vibe here is superb, and the staff is incredibly cooperative, making the experience even better. If you're looking for a fun and lively place for entertainment or events, SHOTT Mumbai is definitely worth checking out!

featured_reviews.name: Darshak Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had our office party at Dave & Buster’s Mumbai and it turned out to be a fantastic team outing spot. The combination of arcade games, bowling, food, music, and lively ambience made it a perfect venue for corporate gatherings and team bonding activities.

featured_reviews.name: Parth Rode
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience. They have an array of games from which you can play and you will even not know when the time passes by. Executive Kajal helped a lot by explaining the layover and the games available. They are very professional and courteous! Enjoyed a lot.

featured_reviews.name: Vayu Tiwari

Best place!

Very Huge space with a very wide variety of arcade games to enjoy. They have a big screen in their dining area and bar.
The bowling alley is great with good lighting and effects

The staff were very helpful friendly, and supportive and generally made our experience amazing.

I highly recommend everyone visit this place. It's perfect for all age groups.

featured_reviews.name: Tarun Poojari
featured_reviews.review_text: Dave & Buster’s in Andheri West, your next go-to spot for nonstop fun. This massive arcade has exciting games, VR experiences and bowling, plus a restaurant and sports bar all under one roof, making it perfect for parties and corporate events. We tried every arcade game and loved them all. We also tried their food and loved everything from starters to desserts. You can truly Eat, Drink & Play here

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Gandhi

I wanted to take a moment to recognize your staff members for their outstanding service during our recent visit.

Harsh, Mamta & Komal

They genuinely care about helping customers have a positive experience.

Staff members like this are the reason we'll keep coming back to Dave and busters.  My sincere appreciation for their patience, problem-solving skills, and excellent guidance.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing time at Dave & Buster’s, Infiniti Mall (Andheri West)!
The place is absolutely massive — around 22,000 sq. ft. of pure fun and food. The ambience is super high-energy — part carnival, part sports bar, part social lounge. You’ll find zones for arcade games, VR experiences, Nitro Bowling with cool lighting, hi-tech darts, and big screens showing live cricket, football & F1. Perfect for birthdays, group hangouts, or even a casual fun evening.
We tried quite a few things from the menu:
🥤 Dare Devil Mocktail, Fight Mode Mocktail, Purple Breeze Mocktail, Oreo Shake – all refreshing and perfectly balanced.
🍕 Farmhouse Flatbread (Veg) – crisp and loaded with toppings.
🍗 Chicken Wings and Game Day Grub Platter (Non-Veg) – juicy, flavorful, and great for sharing.
🍔 Brekky Smash Chicken Burger – one of the best!
🌯 Veg Paneer Wrap and Creamy Garden Pasta – delicious and satisfying.
🍫 Tiramisu & Smoor Chocolate Cheesecake were the perfect sweet endings.
They’ve got a dedicated food & snack area, VR and arcade sections, bowling lanes, and live sports screening, making it one of the best entertainment spots in Andheri West.
Service was quick, staff were friendly, and the overall vibe was fun and energetic.
💡 Tip: Come in groups, buy a game card, and spend some time exploring — it’s totally worth it!
Highly recommend for anyone looking to combine great food, drinks, and games under one roof. 🎮🍔🍹

featured_reviews.name: Myra's Corner
featured_reviews.review_text: We came here after watching reels to let the kids enjoy the ball pool, but it was a very bad experience. The staff was not cooperative at all, and they were not even allowing my 13-month-old baby to play for 5min . The place is not fresh or well-maintained, and the environment feels very dark and dull. I would suggest not visiting this place just by watching paid reels — please read genuine reviews before coming.

featured_reviews.name: Syed Hadi
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to spend some time with your friends or kids, it is too bowling. All is and rage room as well as a small trampoline park which includes the ball pit. There are also basic games The overall pricing is good and the facilities are average. However, the location is very good so it is a recommended place affair in the area and have some time to spend.

featured_reviews.name: gaurav vaikul
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst its not what you see in reel my 13month infant was charged full amount for the trampoline and ball pool section and when I asked where it’s written that Infant will be charged as full adult they simply don’t have answer pls stay away

featured_reviews.name: Akash Saindane
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointing experience at Rush Trampoline Park. We visited after watching Instagram reels and expected much more, but the actual experience was not up to the mark. Activities were very limited and it mostly felt like just a ball pool setup. Considering the overall experience, the pricing is too high and not worth the money. Management and coordination also need improvement. Would not recommend based on our experience.

featured_reviews.name: Poonam S
featured_reviews.review_text: Really disappointed. This is a very small gaming area with some video games, a small section created for trampolines and it also has a wrecking room and 2 bowling lanes. Totally disappointed on seeing the size of the place. Also smells like pee, looks like same broom is used to clean toilets and main area of play. It is not like what it looks in the pics. Doesn't compare to other video gaming places like game, smash, timezone etc. Not worth the travel and time

featured_reviews.name: Saonli Roy
featured_reviews.review_text: This indoor play area is nicely decorated and clean. My kid enjoy a lot, it was hard to bring him back. Price is actually high, for 1 hour they charged 600 ₹. Additional 30 min, 300 ₹. That is too too much, I did not find it justified. So i only kept my kid for 1 h.

featured_reviews.name: Abhigyan Bafna
featured_reviews.review_text:
The wreaking room was okay. But what ruined the experience was Bowling.

The bowling here uses old string tech which causes errors, long wait times and wrong fouls. The way they get you is that the price for it is 600 for 2. But not worth it. Can go for  rage room as an experience.

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Never go to this place. AC was off there were mosquitos flying over there. In bowling the pins are tied with ropes and if you trying to strike in bowling it is impossible. Bowling ball does not come out of machine you have to put hand in the machine and remove it. Their staff was just standing and not even helped even after asked. Pathetic
